pages.text: Smithies' Construct tools are built from parts rather than crafted in a grid. Shape each part from a pattern and a material at the Part Builder, then assemble the parts at the Tool Station.
Every part carries the stats of the material it is made from, so the same tool can be fast and fragile or slow and sturdy depending on what you build it from.
Heavier tools — the hammer, excavator, lumber axe, cleaver, and the bows — must be assembled at the Tool Forge instead of the Tool Station.

pages.title: Pattern and Part Crafting
pages.text: Craft a Stencil Table to cut blank patterns into shapes, and a Part Builder to turn those patterns into tool parts.

pages.title: Assembly Stations
pages.text: Assemble parts into tools at the Tool Station. Heavier tools need the Tool Forge.
